issues.description: The type of the price field for StockIngredient is inconsistent across artifacts: the problem statement and UML specify an int price and the solution implements price as an int, but the template StockIngredient.java declares price as a double (and its constructor/getPrice use double). This will confuse students when they implement calculateTotalPrice (which the spec says returns int) because summing double prices into an int accumulator will cause type/compilation issues.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the price type consistent across all artifacts. Prefer changing the template StockIngredient to use int for the price (constructor parameter, field type, and getPrice return type) to match the problem statement and the solution. Alternatively, if double prices are desired, update the problem statement and solution to specify and use double consistently and adjust calculateTotalPrice to return a double.
